name: BridgeDb_xrefs
description: Map a biological identifier across databases using BridgeDb. Given an identifier from one database (e.g., HMDB0000122 from HMDB), returns equivalent identifiers in all other supported databases (ChEBI, KEGG, PubChem, Wikidata, CAS, etc.). Supports genes, proteins, metabolites, and other biological entities across 45+ databases and 30+ organisms. System codes: Ch=HMDB, Ce=ChEBI, Ck=KEGG Compound, En=Ensembl, H=HGNC, S=UniProt, L=NCBI Gene, Cpc=PubChem-compound, Ik=InChIKey. Use this when you need to convert between database identifiers for the same biological entity.

identifier.description: The identifier to look up (e.g., 'HMDB0000122' for glucose, 'ENSG00000141510' for TP53, '17234' for ChEBI glucose)

source.description: Source database name or system code. Common codes: Ch=HMDB, Ce=ChEBI, Ck=KEGG Compound, En=Ensembl, H=HGNC, S=UniProt, L=NCBI Gene, Cpc=PubChem-compound

source_database.description: Alias for source. Source database name or system code.

organism.description: Organism name (default: Human). Options include: Human, Mouse, Rat, Yeast, Worm, Fruit fly, Zebra fish, Arabidopsis thaliana, and others.

target_source.description: Optional: filter results to a specific target database. Use database name or system code.

target_database.description: Alias for target_source. Filter results to a specific target database.

organism.description: The organism used for the lookup

system_code.description: BridgeDb system code for this database

name: BridgeDb_search
description: Search for biological identifiers by name using BridgeDb. Enter a gene name, metabolite name, or protein name and get matching identifiers from supported databases. Useful for finding database-specific IDs when you only know the common name. Searches across all database sources available for the specified organism. Returns identifier-database pairs. For example, searching 'glucose' returns matches from MetaCyc, KEGG, and other databases.

organism.description: Organism name (default: Human). Options: Human, Mouse, Rat, Yeast, Worm, Fruit fly, Zebra fish, etc.
The organism used for the search

name: BridgeDb_attributes
description: Get properties and attributes for a biological identifier from BridgeDb. Returns metadata such as molecular formula, molecular weight, InChI, InChIKey, synonyms, and other database-specific attributes. Especially useful for metabolites (HMDB, ChEBI, KEGG compound IDs) to get chemical properties, and for genes to get symbol and name information. System codes: Ch=HMDB, Ce=ChEBI, Ck=KEGG Compound, En=Ensembl, H=HGNC, S=UniProt.

identifier.description: The identifier to look up (e.g., 'HMDB0000122' for glucose, '17234' for ChEBI glucose)

source.description: Source database name or system code. Common: Ch=HMDB, Ce=ChEBI, Ck=KEGG Compound, En=Ensembl, H=HGNC, S=UniProt

organism.description: Organism name (default: Human). Options: Human, Mouse, Rat, Yeast, etc.

attributes.description: Attributes for the identifier, keyed by BridgeDb's own attribute name. BridgeDb serves one 'name<TAB>value' line per attribute and the set depends on the entity: a metabolite answers Symbol, BrutoFormula, InChI, InChIKey, SMILES, 'Monoisotopic Weight' and a Synonym line per synonym (28 for D-glucose); a gene or protein answers Symbol, Type, Description and Chromosome. Empty object when BridgeDb knows the identifier but holds no attributes for it (HTTP 204).

Symbol.description: Common name or gene symbol, e.g. 'D-Glucose' for HMDB0000122, 'TP53' for ENSG00000141510.

BrutoFormula.description: Molecular formula, e.g. 'C6H12O6'. Metabolite entries only.

InChI.description: Full InChI including stereochemistry layers, e.g. 'InChI=1S/C6H12O6/c7-1-2-3(8)4(9)5(10)6(11)12-2/h2-11H,1H2/t2-,3-,4+,5-,6-/m1/s1'.

Monoisotopic Weight.description: Monoisotopic mass as a STRING, e.g. '180.063388116' -- BridgeDb serves it as text, so it needs converting before arithmetic. Note the space in the property name.

Synonyms.description: Every alternative name BridgeDb holds, collected from its repeated 'Synonym' lines -- 28 for D-glucose, spanning spellings ('beta-D-Glucose', 'b-D-Glucose', 'beta-D-Glucose'), trade names ('Dextrose') and the systematic name. The one field here that is a list rather than a string.

SMILES.description: Isomeric SMILES for the structure, e.g. 'OC[C@H]1O[C@@H](O)[C@H](O)[C@@H](O)[C@@H]1O'. Metabolite entries only, and the only machine-readable structure here besides InChI.

Type.description: What kind of entity the identifier names, e.g. 'protein_coding' for a gene. Gene and protein entries only.

Description.description: The source database's own description of the entity, with its provenance appended, e.g. 'tumor protein p53 [Source:HGNC Symbol;Acc:HGNC:11998]'.

Chromosome.description: Chromosome the gene sits on, as a bare name without a 'chr' prefix, e.g. '17'.

additionalProperties.description: BridgeDb may answer an attribute name beyond the ones above; the value is then its string, or a list where the name repeated across lines.
